restaurant_name: ราม 53 คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: This private hospital has terrible staff. They make no effort to assist customers and are unable to issue medication documents for reimbursement. It's unsuitable for those needing treatment and reimbursement documents because the staff claim they don't have them and have never issued them. Customers are paying for the service; even a little help would be appreciated, but they don't. Service professionals should have a better service mindset. If they can't fulfill a customer's request, they should at least apologize or be more enthusiastic in providing service. They only provide medical certificates for reimbursement purposes; they don't have them.
